definitions.explanation: A retail store that sells furniture such as desks, chairs, beds, and shelves.

examples.japanese: {家具店|かぐてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a desk at a furniture store.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧ (furniture) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop/store). This follows the standard Japanese pattern of combining a product category with ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ to name a type of shop.
